At the effluent pump station wet well, the Discharger disinfects the secondary-treated wastewater with sodium hypochlorite to reduce bacteriological concentrations and pumps the disinfected secondary-treated wastewater to the OOO.

The Discharger can also temporarily send the disinfected secondary-treated wastewater to the secondary effluent equalization pond (new emergency pond) to ensure flows discharged from the SLRWRF to the OOO remain less than the permitted flow through the San Luis Rey Land Outfall.
Screenings from the headworks and solids from the grit removal are collected onsite and trucked to a local landfill.
